title: IndeRunError
description: The error shape thrown by run() (wrapped in an IndeRunException) when execution fails — via validation, routing (no eligible provider), or every attempted provider failing. Never returned as part of a successful TaskResult.

schemaVersion.description: Contract schema version used to interpret the error payload.

errorClass.description: Normalized error taxonomy, shared with TaskResult.telemetry.errorClass: CapabilityMismatch (request needs something no eligible provider supports), Offline/Unavailable (provider unreachable or not ready), AuthError (credential/auth failure), RateLimited (provider throttled the request), Timeout (provider exceeded its execution budget), Internal (unexpected engine-side failure).

message.description: Human-readable error message suitable for logs and developer diagnostics.

runId.description: Opaque run identifier associated with the failed execution, if available.

providerId.description: Identifier of the provider associated with the failure, if execution reached a provider.

retryable.description: Whether retrying the same request may succeed.

retryAfterMs.description: Optional suggested delay before retrying, in milliseconds.

details.description: Optional structured diagnostic details. It must not contain raw secrets.
